_comment: dsh-voice-alerts runtime config. The plugin re-reads it by mtime, so edits apply immediately.
The shipped defaults work as-is; this file is only needed to change something.
You can also toggle alerts from chat with /voice-alerts on|off.
Spoken lines and synthesis settings live in assets/clips.json, not here.
_playerNote: auto probes ffplay and falls back to Windows PowerShell. Use 'ffplay' or 'powershell' to force one.
_ffplayPathNote: null means resolve ffplay from PATH; set an absolute path if it is not on PATH.
_playPs1Note: null means auto-detect the fallback script. Playback still works when it is missing, via an inline -EncodedCommand.
_clipsDirNote: Optional extra clip directory, checked before the user and packaged directories. Handy for swapping one scene.
_volumeNote: 0-100. Applies to ffplay only; the PowerShell player follows the system volume.
_minIntervalNote: Repeat triggers of the same scene inside this window are dropped.
_coalesceNote: Events inside this window are collapsed to the single highest-priority scene.
_interruptNote: Whether a new alert cuts off the one playing. true keeps the most important alert audible.
_commandNameNote: Slash command name. A collision with another plugin loses only the command, not the alerts.
_waitingToolsNote: Tool names that mean the agent is about to wait for you; they play the needs-input clip.
_approvalNote: Also speak on an approval request. Only fires under the 'ask' approval policy.
